sampling.selection: Within each declared stratum, sort canonical_id lexically and select evenly spaced positions floor((i + 0.5) * stratum_size / requested_n); deduplicate across strata.
sampling.family_assignment: Research-only crosswalk from function census identity or nonfunction claim_class plus the stated route-facet condition; not a native tag, equivalence claim, or canonical classification.

method_use_boundary: No typed METHOD_USE relation is encoded in the sampled route rows or the inspected function/nonfunction authority rows; Task179 R0 method slots are not linked to these IDs in the inspected package surface. This is scoped to the inspected interfaces, not an exhaustive repository-wide absence proof.
